The '''1936 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship''' was the 50th staging of the All-Ireland [[hurling]] championship since its establishment by the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]] in 1887. The championship began on 26 April 1936 and ended on 6 September 1936.

[[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] entered the championship as [[1935 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|defending champions]], however, they were defeated by [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] in the [[1936 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|All-Ireland final]] on a score line of 5–6 to 1–5 victory.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |title=All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Roll of Honour |publisher=The GAA website |access-date=24 July 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110905085701/http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |archive-date=5 September 2011 }}</ref>

==Teams==

A total of thirteen teams contested the championship, however, there were some changes from the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1935|1935 championship]]. [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] declined to field a team in Leinster, while in Munster [[Kerry GAA|Kerry]] reentered the championship after a long absence.

==Championship statistics==
===Miscellaneous===

* The All-Ireland semi-final between [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] and [[Galway GAA|Galway]] is suspended ten minutes into the second half when a melee develops and a Galway player is knocked unconscious. At a subsequent meeting of the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]]'s (GAA) Central Council, Limerick were awarded the match as Galway were suspended from the championship.
